import sys, importlib.util, statistics, timeit
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
import numpy as np
from deap.tools import Logbook
from sklearn_genetic.utils import cv_scores as new
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("old",Path(".agent-runs/cv_before.py"))
old=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(old)
rng=np.random.default_rng(2603)
for heterogeneous in (False,True):
    log=Logbook()
    for i in range(512):
        folds=5+int(heterogeneous and i%2==1)
        row=rng.normal(size=folds)
        times=rng.uniform(size=folds).astype(np.float32 if heterogeneous and i%3==0 else np.float64)
        if i%3==0: times[0]=np.nan
        if i%5==0: row[-1]=np.nan
        log.record(parameters=dict(cv_scores=row,test_a=row,train_a=row[::-1],test_b=-row,train_b=-row[::-1],fit_time=times,score_time=times[::-1],depth=i%7,features=[1,i%2,0]))
    for kind in ("hpo","features"):
        def run(mod):
            if kind=="hpo": return mod.create_gasearch_cv_results_(log,SimpleNamespace(parameters=["depth"]),True,["a","b"],False)
            return mod.create_feature_selection_cv_results_(log,True,["a","b"],False)
        a,b=run(old),run(new)
        assert list(a)==list(b)
        for k in a:
            assert type(a[k])==type(b[k])
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(a[k],b[k],strict=True)
        if not heterogeneous:
            old_t,new_t=[],[]
            for j in range(5):
                for mod,out in ([(old,old_t),(new,new_t)] if j%2==0 else [(new,new_t),(old,old_t)]):
                    out.append(timeit.timeit(lambda:run(mod),number=1))
            print(kind,'old',statistics.median(old_t),'new',statistics.median(new_t),flush=True)
print('column parity passed: uniform and mixed historical records',flush=True)

import importlib.util, time, statistics
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
import numpy as np
from sklearn.datasets import load_diabetes
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeRegressor
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits
from sklearn_genetic import GASearchCV,GAFeatureSelectionCV,genetic_search
from sklearn_genetic.space import Integer
from sklearn_genetic.utils import cv_scores
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("old",Path(".agent-runs/cv_before.py"))
old=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(old)
X,y=load_diabetes(return_X_y=True)
with threadpool_limits(1):
    for cls,name in [(GASearchCV,"create_gasearch_cv_results_"),(GAFeatureSelectionCV,"create_feature_selection_cv_results_")]:
        times=[[],[]]
        for i in range(4):
            expected=None
            for j in ([0,1] if i%2==0 else [1,0]):
                params={"param_grid":{"max_depth":Integer(1,12),"min_samples_leaf":Integer(1,10)}} if cls==GASearchCV else {}
                search=cls(DecisionTreeRegressor(random_state=10),population_size=8,generations=3,cv=3,scoring="r2",n_jobs=1,random_state=333+i,verbose=False,**params)
                with patch.object(genetic_search,name,getattr((old,cv_scores)[j],name)):
                    start=time.perf_counter()
                    search.fit(X,y)
                    times[j].append(time.perf_counter()-start)
                result=(search.cv_results_,search.predict(X),search.fit_stats_["cross_validate_calls"])
                if expected is not None:
                    assert list(result[0])==list(expected[0])
                    for k in result[0]:
                        if not k.endswith("_time"): np.testing.assert_array_equal(result[0][k],expected[0][k],strict=True)
                    np.testing.assert_array_equal(result[1],expected[1])
                    assert result[2]==expected[2]
                expected=result
        print(cls.__name__,times, "median old/new",statistics.median(a/b for a,b in zip(*times)),flush=True)
